title: AI voice-clone emergency call
tagline: A frantic cloned voice sounding like a close relative begs for urgent hospital money from an unknown number.
intro: You receive an urgent call from unknown number {{maskedPhone}}. A panicked voice sounding remarkably like your {{relativeRole}} claims they were just in an accident and need ₹{{amount}} sent immediately to a stranger's UPI handle {{scammerVpa}}. Pause, verify independently, and protect your {{bankName}} balance.

payloadTemplate.body: Please help me! My phone broke after a road accident and I'm at the hospital desk. Send ₹{{amount}} right now to the attendant's UPI {{scammerVpa}} — don't call my old number!

steps.label: Hang up & refuse to pay on an unverified call
steps.cue: AI voice clones mimic relatives from short social-media clips. Hang up so you can call your {{relativeRole}}'s real saved number.
steps.explanation: Scammers can clone a family member's voice from a few seconds of public video. Hanging up breaks the panic loop so you can verify directly.

steps.label: Verify your {{bankName}} balance & callback result
steps.cue: After calling your {{relativeRole}}'s saved number and confirming they are safe, verify no transfer left your account.
steps.explanation: Calling the real saved number (or asking a private family safe-word) exposes AI voice clones in seconds while keeping your money untouched.

steps.label: Block {{maskedPhone}} & report {{scammerVpa}} to 1930
steps.cue: Report both the spoofed caller number and the stranger's UPI ID {{scammerVpa}} to 1930.
steps.explanation: Reporting voice-clone emergency numbers and mule UPI IDs helps warn others and block repeat targeting.

notification.title: {{maskedPhone}} · Urgent Call
notification.body: Sounds like your {{relativeRole}} asking for ₹{{amount}} hospital money!

props.agency: Not in your contacts · Possible AI Voice Clone
props.transcript: Please help! I met with an accident and my phone screen cracked. Do not call my regular number, it is off. Send ₹{{amount}} urgently to the hospital attendant's UPI {{scammerVpa}} right now before they refuse admission!

actions.label: Hang up & call {{relativeRole}}'s real saved number
Stay on call & promise to pay immediately

redFlagPhrases: Do not call my regular number
right now before they refuse admission

trapIntents.ANSWER_CALL: Staying on the line keeps you inside the scammer's panic script. Hang up and dial your {{relativeRole}}'s real saved number directly.
trapIntents.ENTER_UPI_PIN: You sent ₹{{amount}} to a scammer's mule UPI ({{scammerVpa}}) without independently calling your {{relativeRole}}'s real number!

notification.title: Your {{relativeRole}} answered & is safe!
notification.body: They never called from {{maskedPhone}} — it was an AI voice-clone scam.

props.note: Callback confirmed your {{relativeRole}} is completely safe. ₹{{amount}} never left your {{bankName}} account.

trapIntents.ACCEPT_COLLECT: Your callback already confirmed the emergency was fake — never send money to {{scammerVpa}}.

props.title: Report Voice-Clone Scam · 1930
props.intro: Block {{maskedPhone}} and report mule UPI handle {{scammerVpa}} to 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in.

critical.title: You paid a stranger's UPI during a voice-clone emergency call
critical.explanation: AI tools can clone a relative's voice from short public audio clips. Whenever someone calls from an unknown number begging for urgent money to a third-party UPI ID, hang up and call your relative back on their saved number (or verify with a family safe-word) before sending a single rupee.
critical.reason: You transferred money under emotional pressure from a cloned voice, so practise independent callback verification next.

redFlags.textFragment: Do not call my regular number
redFlags.label: Blocks independent verification
redFlags.explanation: Scammers always invent an excuse why you cannot call your relative's real saved number.

redFlags.label: Third-party personal UPI
redFlags.explanation: Real hospitals issue official receipts and billing desks — they don't demand urgent transfers to a personal UPI handle.

redFlags.textFragment: right now before they refuse admission
redFlags.label: Emotional panic trigger
redFlags.explanation: Extreme emotional urgency is engineered to bypass calm verification.

hints.step-call: Spot the red flags ('Do not call my regular number' and the stranger's UPI handle), then hang up so you can call your {{relativeRole}}'s real saved number.
hints.step-balance: Your callback confirmed your {{relativeRole}} is safe and your balance is untouched. Tap to proceed to blocking & reporting.
hints.step-report: Pick the AI Voice-Clone / Relative Impersonation reason and submit the 1930 report.
